quizzes.title: Maritime Cooperation: MCQ Practice
quizzes.passage: The 11th Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting was held in New Delhi, and maritime cooperation was one of the main strands of its outcomes. The booklet describes a joint approach to activity at sea, in which the grouping's members contribute to a shared picture of what happens on the water. The approach is presented as a way of improving the monitoring of the seas across the wider region. Naval work is another part of the Quad's activity. The Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission is listed among its major initiatives and is described as an effort to improve maritime coordination among the navies involved. Counterterrorism is also part of the agenda. A tabletop exercise on this subject is listed among the outcomes, and its focus includes planning for joint crisis response. The booklet gives the year in which the exercise is to take place, which is 2026. Data sharing is also among the outcomes, and the booklet lists it as part of the maritime agenda. The Quad's core objective is to promote a Free, Open, Inclusive, Secure and Prosperous Indo-Pacific region, based on the rule of law, freedom of navigation, territorial integrity and the peaceful resolution of disputes. The booklet presents these outcomes as the product of the 11th meeting.

questions.q: Under which declaration was the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission launched?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission was launched under the Wilmington Declaration.

questions.q: Which area is the immediate focus of the Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration?
questions.explanation: The booklet gives immediate emphasis to the Indian Ocean Region.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The Quad's maritime surveillance framework does not draw on the assets of every member.
Reason (R): The framework uses the tracking and monitoring assets of all Quad members.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The booklet says the framework uses the assets of all Quad members, so A is false and R is true.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission
II. Malabar Exercise
III. Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness
IV. Quad Counterterrorism Tabletop Exercise
A. Near real-time maritime data sharing across regional waters
B. Hosted by Australia in 2026
C. Launched under the Wilmington Declaration
D. Annual multilateral naval exercise of Quad members
questions.explanation: The booklet pairs the mission with the Wilmington Declaration, the Malabar Exercise with the annual naval exercise, the partnership with data sharing and the tabletop exercise with Australia.

questions.q: Which country will host the next edition of the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that India will host the next edition.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Quad maritime cooperation:
I. The maritime surveillance framework uses tracking and monitoring assets of all Quad members.
II. The immediate focus of maritime surveillance is the Arctic Ocean Region.
III. The Malabar Exercise is an annual multilateral naval exercise of Quad members.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because the booklet gives the immediate emphasis as the Indian Ocean Region.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements on maritime cooperation are correct?
I. The Quad Counterterrorism Tabletop Exercise is to be hosted by Australia in 2026.
II. The Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness enables near real-time maritime data sharing.
III. The Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission was launched under the Tokyo Declaration.
IV. The Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission aims to counter illegal maritime activities.
questions.explanation: Statements I, II and IV are correct, while III names the wrong declaration.

questions.q: Which annual multilateral naval exercise of Quad members is named in the outcomes? (Give the name)

questions.q: Through which partnership is near real-time maritime data shared across regional waters? (Give the full name)
questions.answer: Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness
accept: Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness enables near real-time maritime data sharing.

questions.q: Besides naval coordination, what capability does the Quad-at-Sea mission aim to enhance? (One word)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the mission aims to improve naval coordination, enhance interoperability and counter illegal maritime activities.

questions.q: Which country will host the next edition of the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that India will host the next edition of the mission.

questions.q: Besides illicit maritime activities, what other kind of threat does the maritime surveillance objective aim to monitor? (One word)

quizzes.title: Significance for India: MCQ Practice
quizzes.passage: The Quad brings together India, the United States, Japan and Australia. Its core objective is to promote a Free, Open, Inclusive, Secure and Prosperous Indo-Pacific region based on the rule of law, territorial integrity and the peaceful resolution of disputes. Its roots lie in humanitarian cooperation that followed the Indian Ocean Tsunami. The grouping was revitalised in 2017 amid concerns about China's expanding military and economic influence across the Indo-Pacific. The outcomes of the 11th meeting, held in New Delhi, cover several fields. Technology cooperation is one of them, and it extends across a range of digital and communications areas. The Quad is also presented as a provider of support to the region through a variety of initiatives. Economic work forms another field, and it is linked to reducing vulnerabilities in supply chains. For India, the booklet presents the Quad as a way to strengthen its role in the Indian Ocean Region. The grouping is said to help India monitor activity at sea more effectively. The booklet links these developments to the contemporary global order. The name Quad stands for Quadrilateral Security Dialogue. The booklet describes the Quad in terms of a partnership of four members, and its work spans several sectors, from naval activity to technology and supply chains. Within the wider region, the booklet also refers to a range of Quad Plus engagements.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed among the regional public goods the Quad provides?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists disaster relief, health security, infrastructure support and capacity building, but not nuclear deterrence.

questions.q: Which Chinese strategy in the Indian Ocean does the Quad help India balance?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Quad balances China's growing maritime presence and its String of Pearls strategy in the Indian Ocean.

questions.q: Apart from illegal fishing, which other activity does the Quad's enhanced maritime monitoring help India detect?
questions.explanation: The booklet says enhanced monitoring improves detection of illegal fishing and grey-zone tactics.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The Quad helps India preserve its strategic autonomy.
Reason (R): The Quad enables deeper cooperation with major democracies without entering a formal military alliance.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Quad preserves strategic autonomy by enabling cooperation with major democracies without a formal alliance.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Strategic counterbalance
II. Technology cooperation
III. Regional public goods
IV. Supply-chain resilience
A. Opposes unilateral attempts to alter the status quo
B. 5G/6G and Open RAN networks
C. Disaster relief and health security
D. Diversification under the China+1 strategy
questions.explanation: Strategic counterbalance matches A, technology cooperation matches B, regional public goods match C and supply-chain resilience matches D.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Quad:
I. The Quad helps India balance China's growing maritime presence.
II. The Quad's technology cooperation includes secure digital infrastructure.
III. The Quad's supply-chain work aims to increase dependence on dominant suppliers.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement III is wrong because the booklet says supply-chain work reduces vulnerabilities and diversifies sources beyond dominant suppliers.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements about the Quad's significance are correct?
I. The Quad's technology cooperation covers 5G/6G and Open RAN networks.
II. The Quad is a formal military alliance.
III. The Quad's supply-chain work supports diversification under the China+1 strategy.
IV. The Quad lacks any technology cooperation agenda.
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II and IV contradict the booklet.

questions.q: Which generation of mobile technology, after 5G, is listed under the Quad's technology cooperation? (Give the answer as a number with unit)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists 5G/6G technologies under the Quad's technology cooperation.

questions.q: Which networks, whose name stands for open radio access networks, are listed under technology cooperation? (Give the acronym)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists Open RAN networks under the Quad's technology cooperation.

questions.q: Supply-chain resilience supports diversification under which strategy? (Give the name)
questions.explanation: The booklet says supply-chain resilience supports diversification under the China+1 strategy.

questions.q: Apart from illegal fishing, which other tactic does enhanced maritime monitoring help India detect? (Two words)

questions.q: Which Chinese strategy in the Indian Ocean does the Quad help India balance? (Give the name)

questions.q: Besides AI and 5G/6G, which technology field covered by the Quad's technology cooperation deals with protecting digital systems? (One word)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists cybersecurity among the areas of the Quad's technology cooperation.

questions.q: The Quad's strategic counterbalance supports which freedom in the Indo-Pacific? (Give two words)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Quad's strategic counterbalance supports Freedom of Navigation.
